headline: Oil Closes Higher, Gains 15% in October Amid Middle East Supply Tensions
summary: Oil prices closed higher, posting a 15% gain for the month driven by ongoing Middle East conflicts and tensions between Saudi Arabia and the Houthis that threaten energy infrastructure.
why: Crude oil prices directly influence global energy costs, transportation overhead, and economy-wide inflationary pressures.

impacts.name: Brent Crude
impacts.why: Geopolitical conflict in the Middle East directly threatens crude production and transport infrastructure, lifting prices.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Geopolitical escalation and threats to regional energy infrastructure in the Middle East raise supply disruption risks, pushing crude oil futures higher.
